items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: Well Steve Lewis played piano with, what is this man's name? Fredy Kaplan.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. That's right. And I have a wonderful, well a couple of wonderful records by New Orleans Willie Jackson. Yeah. He went up north and he made some, and he made some down here too with us, Steve Lewis, just him and the piano. Yeah.
Oh Steve Lewis, yeah he used to play piano. He played piano right there. Well Steve Lewis played piano with, what is this man's name? Fredy Kaplan.
